futureAuthorityCreates: Secret Manager versions for empty c1-* containers

entries.name: BUSINESS_DELIVERY_ENABLED
entries.notes: Explicit false by default. Report routes require the approved C1 synthetic policy inputs below.

entries.name: BUSINESS_DELIVERY_POLICY_VERSION
entries.notes: Only BD-POLICY-2026-09-29 is approved for internal_synthetic.

entries.name: BUSINESS_DELIVERY_SCOPE
entries.notes: Only internal_synthetic is approved.

entries.name: BUSINESS_DELIVERY_OBSERVED_SINCE
entries.notes: Valid UTC ISO-8601 instant when ingress observation began.

entries.name: BUSINESS_DELIVERY_MAINTENANCE_EMAILS
entries.notes: Comma-separated maintenance/developer identities. Never store the value in this contract or repository.

entries.name: CALENDAR_PILOT_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN
entries.notes: Non-secret. No scheme. Exact isolated Hosting preview host from var.firebase_auth_domain. No fallback to project_id.firebaseapp.com. Do not infer from request Host. Future OAuth (not this source PR): add https://beauessence-clinic-stg-c1a01--internal-preproduction-3u85hkcz.web.app/__/auth/handler on clinic-c1-internal-preproduction-staff. CLOUD_MUTATION = NONE.

entries.name: GOOGLE_CALENDAR_AUTH
entries.notes: CLOUD_ADC for Stage F Cloud Run. No user-managed service-account key. DOMAIN_WIDE_DELEGATION_REQUIRED = NO for a dedicated synthetic calendar ACL-shared to the worker identity.

entries.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
entries.notes: Not mounted on Cloud Run. Local/emulator tests may still use SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON. USER_MANAGED_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_REQUIRED = NO.

entries.name: staff_session_cookie
entries.notes: Cookie __session, HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict. Not an env var.

entries.name: staff_csrf_header
entries.notes: Staff writes require x-csrf-token. Public booking stays anonymous without Bearer.

entries.name: public_booking_accountless
entries.notes: General booking is NO account / NO patient login / NO OTP. Return is phone+DOB. Cloud Run allUsers is Hosting rewrite transport only.

entries.name: hosting_connect_src
entries.notes: Same-origin Hosting rewrite; CSP connect-src 'self'. No staging firebaseapp.com.

entries.name: ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_ROUTES
entries.notes: Local-only switch read by apps/api main.ts: while it is true the API refuses a non-loopback bind. Nothing sets it and it is not cloud configuration.

entries.name: BOOK_PILOT_ENABLED
entries.notes: Isolated BOOK-PILOT module switch (apps/api/src/book-pilot); AppModule does not import that module. Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: BOOK_PILOT_EXPIRES_AT_UTC
entries.notes: Expiry for the isolated BOOK-PILOT module. Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: CALENDAR_PILOT_RUNTIME_MODE
entries.notes: CAL-PILOT worker runtime mode (apps/worker calendar-pilot-runtime). Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: CALENDAR_PILOT_PSEUDONYM_KEY
entries.notes: CAL-PILOT pseudonym key; the value never goes in the repo. Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: CALENDAR_PILOT_READER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
entries.notes: CAL-PILOT reader credential; the value never goes in the repo. Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: CALENDAR_PILOT_WRITER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
entries.notes: CAL-PILOT writer credential; the value never goes in the repo. Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: CALENDAR_PILOT_SOURCE_MAP_JSON
entries.notes: CAL-PILOT source calendar map (calendar identifiers); the value never goes in the repo. Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: CAL_PILOT_MAX_EVENTS
entries.notes: Legacy CAL-PILOT import CLI limit (apps/worker/src/pilot/pilot-import.ts). Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: CAL_PILOT_WINDOW_DAYS
entries.notes: Legacy CAL-PILOT import CLI window (apps/worker/src/pilot/pilot-import.ts). Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: CAL_PILOT_SOURCE_CALENDAR_ID
entries.notes: Legacy CAL-PILOT import CLI input; a real calendar identifier never goes in the repo. Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: CAL_PILOT_TEST_CALENDAR_ID
entries.notes: Legacy CAL-PILOT import CLI input; the value never goes in the repo. Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: CAL_PILOT_PSEUDONYM_KEY
entries.notes: Legacy CAL-PILOT import CLI key; the value never goes in the repo. Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: CAL_PILOT_SOURCE_KEY_FILE
entries.notes: Legacy CAL-PILOT import CLI path to a key file; no key file is stored in the repo. Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: CAL_PILOT_WRITER_KEY_FILE
entries.notes: Legacy CAL-PILOT import CLI path to a key file; no key file is stored in the repo. Not part of the C1 required set; listed so every environment read in apps/api and apps/worker has a class (B-45).

entries.name: GCLOUD_PROJECT
entries.notes: Platform alias of GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT read as a fallback by apps/api and apps/worker.

entries.name: GCLOUD_PROJECT_ID
entries.notes: Platform alias of GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT read as a fallback by apps/api and apps/worker.

entries.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
entries.notes: Path to a key file. GOOGLE_CALENDAR_AUTH=CLOUD_ADC rejects it; no key file is stored in the repo.

entries.name: VITEST
entries.notes: Set by the test runner; apps/api reads it only to detect a test run.
